# access.UpdateRoleInput

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

Changes a custom role (core.role.update); every holder's access changes with it.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `access.UpdateRoleInput` |
| Kind | `command` |
| PII | `none` |
| Tenancy scope | `organization` |
| Permission | `core.role.update` |
